starknet-l1-system-lock.semantic_scope: Starknet L1 core proxy/implementation global state for state updates, L1/L2 messaging, governance/operator state, and related protocol-global storage. One independent singleton dependency namespace is used per reviewed storage owner; proof verification, message payloads, state roots, and EVM execution equivalence are out of scope.

synthetix-system-lock.semantic_scope: Synthetix protocol/token implementation state spanning synth issuance/burn/exchange/settlement and token transfer classes observed in frozen S4. One independent singleton dependency namespace is used per reviewed storage owner; synth accounting, resolver internals, debt ledger semantics, and EVM execution equivalence are out of scope.

purpose: Fifth-batch conservative dependency aliases for protocol/system families materially broader than existing token/router analogues. Each alias reuses only marketplace-router ExecuteRoute as an independent per-storage-owner singleton dependency guard; this preserves conservative family conflicts without claiming EVM state/execution equivalence.
